title: Gina routing.json
description: Route definitions for a Gina bundle. Each key is a route name; the value defines the URL pattern, HTTP method, controller action, and optional middleware chain.

namespace.description: Controller namespace. Maps to controller.<namespace>.js. Groups related routes under the same controller file.

url.description: URL pattern. Use :param for named segments. Multiple patterns can be comma-separated (e.g. "/item/:id, /item/:id/:slug"). The webroot is prepended automatically unless param.ignoreWebRoot is set.

requirements.description: Validation patterns for URL parameters. Keys match :param names. Values are regex strings (prefixed with "/") or validator references (prefixed with "validator::").

param.description: Controller action mapping and static/dynamic params passed to the action.

control.description: Controller action name (camelCase method on the bundle controller).

file.description: Template file path relative to the bundle views directory (without extension). Defaults to the route name.

path.description: Redirect target path. Used with control: "redirect".

ignoreWebRoot.description: When true, the bundle webroot prefix is not prepended to the URL.

title.description: Page title passed to the template.

isPopinContext.description: Set to true for routes rendered inside a popin overlay.

requireAuth.description: Require an authenticated session (#COMPLY1). STRICTLY boolean — any other type refuses to boot, because a truthy string would NOT gate the route. An unauthenticated caller gets a 401, or a 302 to auth.loginRoute for a browser navigation. Cannot be combined with a route-level `cache` block (the cache is read before the gate and its key carries no user identity), nor declared on a method:"ws" route (a handshake never reaches the gate — authenticate in the wsHandler).

roles.description: Restrict the route to callers holding ANY of these roles. IMPLIES requireAuth — an unauthenticated caller can hold no role, so authentication is checked first and a denial is a 401 before it can be a 403. Strictly a non-empty array of non-empty strings; every other declared shape refuses to boot rather than half-gating the route.

policy.description: Name of a `policies/<name>.js` module in the bundle, exporting a SYNCHRONOUS function (user, req) that returns a literal true to allow. IMPLIES requireAuth, and is AND-composed after roles. Registered at boot: a missing, non-function or async module refuses to start rather than denying its route on every request.

public.description: Exempt this route from auth.requireAuthByDefault (#COMPLY10). STRICTLY boolean — a truthy string would NOT exempt it. Meaningful only while the deny-by-default mode is on; declaring it alongside requireAuth / roles / policy is a boot-refused contradiction, since a route cannot be both exempt from authentication and gated by it.

middleware.description: Ordered list of middleware to run before the controller action. Format: "middlewares.<namespace>.<name>".

middlewareIgnored.description: Middleware names to skip for this route (overrides global middleware).

bundle.description: Target bundle name for cross-bundle routing. The request is proxied to the named bundle.

hostname.description: Override target hostname for cross-bundle or external routing.

scopes.description: Allowed scopes for this route. Defaults to the current bundle scope.

negotiate.description: Opt this route into content negotiation (#SPA1). When true, a request carrying `X-Gina-Navigate: fragment` receives the route's layoutless body instead of the full page, and the response advertises `Vary: X-Gina-Navigate`. Absent or false, the route renders exactly as before. A negotiable route never participates in the render cache: the cache key carries no shape dimension, and both serve points run before the shape is resolved — so pairing `negotiate` with `cache` would risk serving a fragment to a page request.

cache.description: Response caching configuration. Use a string for the cache type shorthand, or an object for full control.

oneOf.description: Cache type shorthand. `redis` (shared L2, per-replica L1) also needs the bundle-wide `server.cache.store` (a connectors.json entry) set in settings.json, and a ttl (or invalidateOnEvents).

type.description: Cache backend. `redis` requires the bundle-wide `server.cache.store` (a connectors.json entry) in settings.json; `sliding` is unsupported with `redis`.

sliding.description: Enable sliding window eviction. Defaults to false.

maxAge.description: Absolute ceiling in seconds when sliding is enabled.

invalidateOnEvents.description: Event names that invalidate the cached response.

_comment.description: Internal documentation comment. Stripped at server init.

_sample.description: Example URL for this route. Ignored at runtime.
